newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila plans chicken exports to Singapore, HK.
newsitem.headline: Manila plans chicken exports to Singapore, HK.

text.p: The Philippines plans to export frozen and chilled chicken to neighbouring countries, especially Singapore and Hong Kong, Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Wednesday.
"We may export chicken to Singapore this year if we can solve problems on the cost," Escudero said at a news conference.
Escudero said local poultry producers have attained world-class standards.
However, he added, local chicken is "not yet competitive" in terms of prices because of higher production costs compared with other exporting countries.
Philippine livestock farmers have been importing corn and soymeal in the past several months for animal feed.
Philippine corn prices are more expensive compared to imported corn because of local supply problems, Manila grains traders said.
Last year, local poultry oversupply reached between three to five million kg, Escudero said.
